improvements.change: Added detailed 5-point debugging checklist under new anchor #rpc-wrong-thread-checklist in MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md
improvements.rationale: Dev agent hit 0x8001010E and couldn't action the existing one-line guidance. Checklist gives concrete steps: check UserControl namespaces, static WinRT initializers, DependencyProperty side effects, deferred navigation, and Clipboard timing.

improvements.change: Checklist point 1 specifically addresses UserControls with x:Class in non-root namespaces and how to verify via XamlTypeInfo.g.cs
improvements.rationale: UWP SDK samples use SDKTemplate.* namespaces for shared controls. After migration to a new RootNamespace, the XAML type system may not resolve them, causing 0x8001010E at runtime.

improvements.change: Added sub-section under Threading about DispatcherQueue null-safety in UserControls called from background threads
improvements.rationale: MediaPlayer/AdaptiveMediaSource event handlers fire on threadpool threads. Controls like LogView need the HasThreadAccess + TryEnqueue pattern, but also need a null-guard if called before the control is in the visual tree.
